/help
  Show available commands
/status
  Render provider auth and readiness for configured connections
/models [connection]
  Render model availability, optionally for one connection
/mcp [reload]
  Render MCP server and tool status, or reload MCP server registrations
/session
  Render a structured summary of the current session
/inspect [session|tool <call-id>]
  Inspect the current session or a specific tool call by id
/history [limit]
  Render recent turn history in the chat transcript
/usage [limit]
  Render token, cost, and latency summaries from executed turns
/new
  Create a new session
/compact
  Run runtime compaction on the current branch context
/branch
  Create and switch to a new branch
/cancel
  Cancel the current in-flight turn
/connection [id]
  Show or switch the session connection
/defaults [connection <id>|model <model-id>|use <connection> [model]]
  Show or update global defaults for future sessions
/use <connection> [model]
  Guided connection and model selection with readiness feedback
/help all
  Show advanced slash commands
Contextual controls
  approvals resolve through the approval chooser; queued follow-up state is rendered inline
